import os
import requests

BASE_URL = os.getenv("SOCBENCH_API_BASE_URL", "https://api.socbench.example").rstrip("/")

task_id = os.getenv("MAINTENANCE_TASK_ID", "task-123")
tenant_id = os.getenv("TENANT_ID", "tenant-123")
city = os.getenv("CITY", "New York")

maintenance_response = requests.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/maintenance-tasks/{task_id}/status",
    timeout=30,
)
maintenance_response.raise_for_status()
maintenance_status = maintenance_response.json()

identity_response = requests.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/tenant/identity-verification/status/{tenant_id}",
    timeout=30,
)
identity_response.raise_for_status()
identity_status = identity_response.json()

market_response = requests.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/rental-analysis",
    params={"city": city},
    timeout=30,
)
market_response.raise_for_status()
rental_market_analysis = market_response.json()

properties_response = requests.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/properties",
    timeout=30,
)
properties_response.raise_for_status()
managed_properties = properties_response.json()
